problems.title: Constructing a topology
problems.statement: Let $X=\{a,b,c,d\}$. Construct a topology on $X$ in which $\{a\}$ and $\{a,b\}$ are open but $\{b\}$ is not open. Verify directly that your collection satisfies the topology axioms.

problems.title: Continuity two ways
problems.statement: Let $f:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ be given by $f(x)=3x+2$. Prove that $f$ is continuous using the $\varepsilon$-$\delta$ definition. Then prove that $f$ is continuous by showing that inverse images of open sets are open. Explain how the two arguments are related.

problems.title: A smallest topology
problems.statement: Let $X=\{a,b,c,d,e\}$. Determine the smallest topology on $X$ containing $\{a,b,c\}$, $\{b,c,d\}$, and $\{c,d,e\}$. Justify your answer.
